data.body:
[P2] Retain completed-parent metadata for later checkpoint updates

If a child creates callback B and returns before a wait, the next invocation skips that child while B is still STARTED. B is absent from `updated_operations`, so this loop retains no parent reference. If B completes during a root step in that resumed invocation, both views defer its terminal notification, then discard it during cleanup because the parent never registers. Checkpoint acknowledgment prevents later redelivery. Collect completed-parent metadata from the full operation snapshot, preserve Invocation view's deferred fallback, and add a regression where B completes after replay skips its parent.
